subject: economics
objective: How responsive is quantity to a price change?
instruction: A Hillcrest water company cuts its price; demand barely moves: At a price of USD 20 the quantity demanded is 1,000 units; after the price changes to USD 15 the quantity demanded is 1,100 units. Use the midpoint (arc) method: percentage change = change / average of the two values. Price elasticity of demand = percentage change in quantity / percentage change in price, reported as a positive number (absolute value). Revenue = price x quantity. Point elasticity from the start = (change in Q / Q1) / (change in P / P1). Required: percentage change quantity, percentage change price, price elasticity of demand, revenue 1, revenue 2, revenue change.
